Name: Mahjong Advisor
Author: Akari
Punchline: Discard advice and optional auto-play for Doman Mahjong.
Description:
Reads your Doman Mahjong hand and recommends a discard, ranked by hand speed against deal-in risk. Manual suggestion mode is the default; an optional auto-play mode can send the same inputs for you on casual tables. Auto-play is off until you enable it with /mjadv auto on and can be stopped instantly with /mjadv stop.

Discard piles and called-meld strips are found automatically. /mjadv nodes is only needed if detection fails on your client.
